posts.query:
SELECT M.mukey, M.musym, M.muname, A.drclassdcd, A.flodfreqdcd, A.hydclprs, L.areasymbol, L.areaname, S.saverest
FROM mapunit M LEFT JOIN muaggatt A ON A.mukey = M.mukey JOIN legend L ON L.lkey = M.lkey LEFT JOIN sacatalog S ON S.areasymbol = L.areasymbol
WHERE M.mukey IN (SELECT * FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('point(-66.076454 18.459153)'))
